title: An AI guide's master on its way to becoming a guide (the worker API)

failure.description: Why it failed, null unless failed: bad_audio, real_voice_exists, voice_withdrawn, licence_changed (its singer hasn't accepted the AI voice licence's current terms), template_changed, publish_failed (encoding or storage broke after its tries: send it again) or expired (never completed within the hour). A file of the wrong size or hash is refused at complete (409) and stays uploading.

guideId.description: The guide it became, once published.
